meta.name: colorize
meta.description: Add strategic color to features that are too monochromatic or lack visual interest. Makes interfaces more engaging and expressive.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为界面添加色彩，提升视觉吸引力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望让单调的界面变得更生动有趣
copy.tagline_en: Add color to interfaces for better visual appeal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to make monochromatic interfaces more engaging

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的设计，找出缺少色彩的地方，然后有策略地添加颜色来增强视觉层次、语义含义和情感表达。它会使用 OKLCH 色彩空间，确保颜色和谐且符合无障碍标准。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 为某个界面或组件添加颜色，或者提到设计看起来太单调、缺乏视觉趣味时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个仪表盘界面加点颜色
say.note: Claude 会分析当前设计并添加有意义的颜色。

say.text: 这个按钮太灰了，让它更突出一些
say.note: Claude 会为按钮添加品牌色或强调色。

say.text: 给这些状态标签加上语义颜色
say.note: Claude 会为成功、错误、警告等状态分配对应颜色。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your design for missing color and strategically adds it to enhance visual hierarchy, semantic meaning, and emotional tone. It uses OKLCH color space and ensures accessibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add color to an interface or component, or mention that a design looks too monochromatic or lacks visual interest.

say_en.text: Add some color to this dashboard interface.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and add meaningful colors.

say_en.text: This button is too gray, make it stand out more.
say_en.note: Claude will apply brand or accent color.

say_en.text: Add semantic colors to these status labels.
say_en.note: Claude will assign colors for success, error, warning, etc.
